title: Wick Liquor Boulevard Shattered 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Boulevard Shattered by Wick Liquor takes the original fruit punch and Loganberry blend of Boulevard and adds a crisp menthol finish. The tropical medley and tart berry tones are given an icy lift, creating a vape that balances sweetness, tang, and a cooling edge. Each bottle contains 100ml of e-liquid in a 120ml Shortfill, leaving space for two 10ml nicotine shots. Adding two 18mg shots produces 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Blended at 70VG/30PG, Boulevard Shattered is made for sub-ohm tanks and high-powered kits, delivering dense vapour and striking flavour clarity. Produced in the UK, Wick Liquor’s Shattered line reimagines its most popular flavours with a frosty menthol kick, offering a fresh spin on familiar favourites.
